Ctrl+Backspace: Deletes word to left of cursor
Ctrl+Del: Deletes word to right of cursor
Ctrl+E: Toggle Aligh selected text or line to center on/off
Ctrl+End: Moves the cursor to the end of the document
Ctrl+Home: Moves the cursor to the beginning of the document
Ctrl+J: Toggle Aligh selected text or line to justify on/off
Ctrl+L: Toggle Aligh selected text or line to left on/off
Ctrl+Left Arrow: Move one word to the left
Ctrl+N: Opens new window with a blank document
Ctrl+R: Toggle Aligh selected text or line to right on/off
Ctrl+Right Arrow: Move one word to the right
Ctrl+Shift+>: Increase selected font +1pts up to 12pt and then increase font +2pts
Ctrl+Shift+<: Decrease selected font -1pts if 12pt or lower; if above 12, decreases font by +2pt
Ctrl+Spacebar: Reset highlighted text to the default font
F7: Spellcheck and grammar check selected text or document
Shift+Enter: Create a soft break instead of a new paragraph
Shift+F3: Switch between uppercase/lowercase/capital letter at the beginning of every line
Shift+F7: Open Thesaurus check on the selected word
